mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, mode, app_key_enc AS appKeyEnc, app_secret_enc AS appSecretEnc, account_no_enc AS accountNoEnc, product_code AS productCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_kis_credential WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mode = #{mode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_kis_credential (user_id, mode, app_key_enc, app_secret_enc, account_no_enc, product_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mode}, #{appKeyEnc}, #{appSecretEnc}, #{accountNoEnc}, #{productCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_kis_credential SET app_key_enc = #{appKeyEnc}, app_secret_enc = #{appSecretEnc}, account_no_enc = #{accountNoEnc}, product_code = #{productCode}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
